Subject: Billing & procurement preflight — Redwood <> HyperEdge

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick post-call recap and a short billing checklist so your procurement team can move this along without surprises.

Call recap (2/26):
- Scope: Pilot (2 nodes, ~50k tokens/day) -> expect monthly hosted consumption.
- Commercial path: HyperEdge leaning toward PO-based procurement for startups; evaluating marketplace option but not committed.
- Key ask: confirm invoice format, tax info, billing address, and requested net terms.

Action items / inputs we need from you to generate a pilot invoice and PO-ready SOW:
1) Billing route: Will you require a PO for pilot invoices or will a company credit card cover the initial month? (please confirm)
2) Billing address and legal name exactly as it should appear on invoices
3) Tax/VAT or tax-exempt ID (if applicable) and where to send tax forms
4) Preferred invoice format (PDF single-page summary, itemized CSV, EDI)
5) Requested payment terms (Net30 / Net45 / Net60) and whether approvals are required from accounts-payable
6) Any PO template requirements (we can accept your PO or issue our standard invoice; attach if you have a spec)
7) Marketplace interest: are you exploring AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace as an alternative procurement path?

I attached our Redwood_Invoice_Template.pdf to show the fields we can populate. Once you confirm items above we will:
- Issue a pilot SOW and provisional invoice (to be finalized on PO receipt)
- Rishi will handle the net-terms review and finance setup
- Provide our billing endpoint and PO submission email (billing@redwood.com)

Timing: If we get answers by EOD Monday (3/1), we can have a PO-ready invoice/SOW to you by Wed (3/3).

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear recap. Answers below from procurement (copied procureops):

1) Billing route: We plan to use our standard PO process for any vendor spend > $1k. Pilot should be on PO.
2) Billing name/address:
   HyperEdge Inc
   Attn: Accounts Payable
   210 Mission Bay Blvd S
   San Francisco, CA 94158
3) Tax/VAT: US EIN: 27-1234567 (no VAT); will provide W-9 if needed.
4) Invoice format: PDF is preferred (monthly consolidated with line items per date). CSV optional.
5) Payment terms: Procurement prefers Net45 for new vendors; they can sometimes approve Net30 for strategic pilots but will require an approval workflow.
6) PO template: attaching our PO spec (HyperEdge_PO_Spec.xlsx). PO number will be generated once SOW/invoice fields align.
7) Marketplace: We're interested in AWS Marketplace but must see pricing parity and how invoicing flows through our tooling. For pilot, direct PO is simplest.

Procurement also asked for the following fields to be present on the invoice to avoid manual rework:
- PO number (if provided)
- Billing contact name and email
- Line-itemized usage with date ranges
- Tax ID and Company legal name

Let us know if Redwood can provide consolidated monthly billing at month-end and an invoice reference that maps to our PO.

Regards,
Alex Hsu
Head of Finance Operations, HyperEdge
alex.hsu@hyperedge.com
Attachment: HyperEdge_PO_Spec.xlsx

Rishi / Steph — forwarding procurement's response. Quick notes:
- They require PO for pilot and prefer Net45. Can we approve Net45 for a pilot at this stage? If not, what guardrails (credit check, payment hold, or pilot deposit) do we need?
- They want consolidated monthly PDF with line items by date range and PO number mapping. Attached PO spec.
- Marketplace interest: they asked about AWS marketplace parity. Steph, can you confirm whether Marketplace billing would still allow HyperEdge to use their own PO flow or if it forces marketplace invoicing?

Proposed commerce flow if finance approves:
1) Redwood issues SOW + provisional invoice using HyperEdge legal details
2) HyperEdge issues PO referencing our invoice line items
3) We finalize invoice and send consolidated PDF at month-end to billing@hyperedge.com

If Net45 cannot be approved for pilots, we could request a 50% upfront deposit and Net30 remaining. Thoughts?

-Neha

Alex / procureops — thanks for the quick answers and the PO spec. Next steps from our side:

1) Finance review: Rishi will confirm whether we can approve Net45 for this pilot or whether a partial deposit is required. He should be able to confirm by EOD today.
2) SOW + provisional invoice: Attached SOW-template.docx; I will populate with pilot quantities and send a provisional invoice that aligns with your PO fields. Can you confirm the billing contact email we should put on the invoice? (e.g., ap@hyperedge.com)
3) PO submission: When ready, please have procurement send the signed PO to billing@redwood.com and include the PO number on the first page of the document. That will ensure automated matching in our AP system.
4) Marketplace note: We support AWS Marketplace; however, marketplace purchases go through a different invoicing workflow (vendor-side reporting). For pilot speed, direct PO is usually fastest — happy to revisit marketplace if you want to purchase recurring production capacity later.

Deliverables I will send once finance confirms terms:
- Pilot SOW (editable doc)
- Provisional invoice populated with your legal name, billing address, and EIN
- Instructions for PO submission and contact for any accounting exceptions

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.
